# netbox_inventory_item_templates (Data Source)

Lists inventory_item_template objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_inventory_item_templates" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-inventory_item_template" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: component_id, component_id__empty, component_id__gt, component_id__gte, component_id__lt, component_id__lte, component_id__n, component_type, component_type__n, created, created__empty, created__gt, created__gte, created__lt, created__lte, created__n, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, device_type_id, device_type_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, label, label__empty, label__ic, label__ie, label__iew, label__iregex, label__isw, label__n, label__nic, label__nie, label__niew, label__nisw, label__regex, last_updated, last_updated__empty, last_updated__gt, last_updated__gte, last_updated__lt, last_updated__lte, last_updated__n, manufacturer, manufacturer__n, manufacturer_id, manufacturer_id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, parent_id, parent_id__n, part_id, part_id__empty, part_id__ic, part_id__ie, part_id__iew, part_id__iregex, part_id__isw, part_id__n, part_id__nic, part_id__nie, part_id__niew, part_id__nisw, part_id__regex, q, role, role__n, role_id, role_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `inventory_item_templates` (Attributes List) The matching inventory_item_templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inventory_item_templates))

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--inventory_item_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inventory_item_templates`

Read-Only:

- `component_id` (Number) Id of the component template named by component_type.
- `component_type` (String) Type of the component template the item is bound to, e.g. dcim.interfacetemplate. Requires component_id.
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. NetBox refuses to move a template to another type.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `name` (String)
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent inventory item template.
- `part_id` (String) Manufacturer part number.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the inventory item role.
- `url` (String)
